cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nina wants an uncomplicated birthday dinner. Let's get noodles instead. Remember how we practised finding the next step in a difficult message?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She invited the whole choir except me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You spotted the painful part quickly enough. The next step isn't to spend tonight rereading it; come out with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What exactly did she say about me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That she's worried the evening will become another argument. That's the part you can use. Let's give you a night where you don't have to defend yourself.

reason: Use the exact Stance as a method of pursuing this Drive rather than a prefixed reminder. Repair missing interaction details or stalled progression explicitly; preserve distinct alternatives and spoken partner contributions.
